messages.author: 950eebea7ef75a7d
messages.subject: Re: Several GoogleVis charts on same page
parts:
I have a 2x2 plot using the code below.  I assume it can be expanded if you need more columns/rows.

mainPanel(

    tags$div(class = "row-fluid",
      tags$div(class = "span5", htmlOutput("scat")),
      tags$div(class = "span5", htmlOutput("resid"))       
    ),
    tags$div(class = "row-fluid",
      tags$div(class = "span5", htmlOutput("qqp")),
      tags$div(class = "span5", plotOutput("residHist"))       
    )
  )

Cheers,

Allen
